text: Loading an event passes its plain description, with an empty-string fallback, to the join-link setter. The setter hides the row when extraction returns no link and caches the returned link otherwise. The join click forwards that cache to openLinkExternally, which delegates to the external protocol service. The component test checks row/button visibility and the exact URI received by a mock service. The accepted test later awaits show after setting each event; original test calls and historical failure reports remain separate. The new lazy binding coexists with an existing eager binding, so it is not proof of exclusive lazy loading.
title: The Calendar join action opens a link parsed from the plain description
